summary_markdown:
Someone noted an omission regarding daily cleaning processes when calculating box data. A separate branch was created to specifically sessionize the boxes, which also includes a forecast setting that can be enabled if needed.

[p1] reported successfully adjusting the calculations by removing deletion and forecast functions, and also including virtual boxes. This adjustment was tested on five boxes over 1.5 months, resulting in successful data generation.
decisions: A separate branch for box sessionization was created.
